app.name: BridgeSign
app.description: Bidirectional communication tool between Algerian Sign Language (LSA) and spoken/written French, Arabic, and English.

dash.welcomeQuote:
Communication is a right, not a barrier.
We're here to help you bridge the gap.
dash.searchPlaceholder: Search a conversation, phrase or topic...
dash.startTwoWaySub: Both people communicate in one place.
dash.signToLangDesc: Sign in front of the camera to translate your signs into spoken and written words.
dash.langToSignDesc: Type or speak to translate spoken phrases into Algerian Sign Language clips.
dash.featurePharmacyDesc: Common clinical phrases and medical vocabulary for pharmacy interactions.
dash.featurePhrasebookDesc: Instant access to frequently used expressions and categorized signs.
dash.featureStoriesDesc: Authentic experiences shared by our Deaf community and healthcare staff.
dash.tryDemoDesc: Experience the complete two-way dialogue without needing camera or microphone access.
dash.noStoriesYet: Be the first to share your experience with BridgeSign.
dash.limitationsText: Limited MVP vocabulary. Does not replace a professional interpreter or provide medical diagnosis.

about.title: About BridgeSign
about.whyText: In Algeria, Deaf people face frequent communication barriers at pharmacies, clinics, and administrative offices without a certified interpreter. BridgeSign serves as an immediate communication bridge.
about.signToLangStep: 1. Camera → 2. Hand & pose landmarks → 3. Temporal sequence → 4. LSA gloss → 5. Spoken sentence
about.langToSignStep: 1. Text/Speech → 2. Normalization → 3. Gloss sequence → 4. Prerecorded sign clips
about.disclaimer: BridgeSign is a communication assistance tool. It does not replace professional interpreters and does not provide medical diagnosis or advice.

stories.title: Real Stories
stories.subtitle: Real voices, experiences, and illustrative usage scenarios demonstrating BridgeSign's intended use cases in healthcare and daily settings in Algeria.
stories.transparencyNotice: These scenarios are illustrative and are not real testimonials. Authentic testimonials will be published once collected with explicit prior consent.
stories.feedbackDesc: Your notes are stored on this device only for your own records. No data is transmitted to a remote server.
stories.fieldTrialTitle: Would you like to test BridgeSign in the field?
stories.fieldTrialDesc: Participate in trials to adapt LSA medical and everyday vocabulary to concrete healthcare communication needs in Algeria.
